notes:
Friends & groups — the launcher group and the in-game party are now the same thing:

- Inviting, accepting, requesting to join, leaving and kicking now work the same in game and in the launcher.
- Accepting an invite in game now puts you in the leader's lobby (you see each other's skins). A "-94" message may still pop up once; the group forms anyway.
- Leaving the party in game no longer loops leave/rejoin.
- Accepting another group's invite while already in a group now moves you cleanly to the new group.
- Removing a friend is now reliable (no more friend coming back or stuck requests).
